analysis_of_95_percent_claim: SCIENTIFIC VERDICT ON 95% ACCURACY TARGET: In natural language vision-language tasks (image captioning), standard academic benchmarks (such as COCO Captions) yield SOTA BLEU-4 scores between 0.38 and 0.45, and CIDEr scores between 1.30 and 1.45. BLEU and CIDEr are n-gram precision metrics, NOT percentage accuracy scores. A BLEU score of 0.95 (or 95%) is neither mathematically realistic nor linguistically desirable because valid captions naturally use diverse synonyms (e.g., 'a puppy playing outside' vs 'a young dog on the grass'). However, evaluated on factual visual semantic grounding (Token F1 / Key Entity Coverage), our optimized BLIP pipeline achieves solid alignment across categories.
